compose.title: Send a request
compose.help: Say what you need. They see it as a request and reply in the conversation.
compose.placeholder: e.g. I need help with… (at least 20 characters)
compose.enquireHelp: Ask a question or ask for a price. Your number stays private until they accept.

compose.applyHelp: Your work profile goes with your application. Add a short note if you want to say more.
compose.noExperienceListed: No skills listed yet. Add them on your work profile.
compose.notePlaceholder: e.g. available immediately, worked on a similar role before…
compose.applyDefaultNote: Applying via Vyapar. Please see my skills above; happy to share more on request.
compose.proposeHelp: Your price, your timeline and a short note. The person who posted sees all three.
compose.coverLetterPlaceholder: Briefly say how you would approach this and why you fit (at least 20 characters)…
compose.attachmentLabel: Attach a work sample (optional, up to 5 MB)
compose.attachmentPlaceholder: Paste a link (e.g. Google Drive, portfolio)
compose.registerHelp: One tap says you are interested. Add a note only if you want to.
compose.registerDefaultNote: I'm interested in this. Please confirm my spot.
compose.contactHelp: Say what you are reaching out about.
compose.messageTooShort: Add a little more detail (at least 20 characters) so they know what you need.
compose.privacyLine: Your phone number is not shared. Replies arrive in Requests and Activity. Never pay in advance.
compose.alreadyOpenWithName: You already have an open request with {{name}}.
compose.targetNotActive: This is no longer accepting requests.

compose.previewEmpty: Your message appears here as you write it.
compose.guide1: Say what you need, where, and by when.

compose.guide3: You can start up to 20 new requests a day.

detail.restrictedLine: Restricted: messages are off for this conversation.
